propositions: JIRA_PAT environment variable is read with empty-string default (get JIRA_PAT, default to empty string) instead of failing when absent
Empty PAT is passed to jira_cls as token_auth without validation, causing the client to fall back to anonymous access instead of raising an error
Missing or empty JIRA_PAT causes misleading JiraError (field does not exist) rather than explicit credential error, misattributing the failure to the wrong root cause
The documented security guarantee that missing JIRA_PAT fails with a named error is not enforced by the code; only assert_env_ready checks it and is only reached from the bootstrap path
Settings resolution must remain total (not raise on missing JIRA_PAT) to preserve Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks via hasattr, so validation must happen at client construction time instead
